_about: Corrections the data build applies on top of the downloaded sources. 'incarnonBases' adds base weapon names that have an Incarnon Genesis in case the wiki parse misses one. 'items' merges fields into a single item by exact name, e.g. {"Tenora Prime": {"note": "..."}}. 'exclude' lists Prime items to leave out entirely (the Founders items can't be obtained; Regulators Prime and Garuda Prime Talons are ability weapons; the Extractor Primes don't count towards mastery). For a Prime that doesn't come from relics you can set 'get' to replace the how-to-get text pulled from the wiki.
